field_legend.id: Canonical boundary feature ID matching overlays.json
field_legend.ly: Boundary overlay layer key (e.g. council_districts, historic_districts, neighborhoods)
field_legend.bb: Bounding box [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat] in WGS84
field_legend.ac: Boundary planar land area in acres (EPSG:2278)
field_legend.bc: Total standing dated building footprints inside boundary (suppress_only & year=0 excluded)
field_legend.ey: Earliest recorded construction year among standing footprints
field_legend.my: Median construction year among standing footprints
field_legend.p75: Standing footprints built prior to 1975 (50-year NRHP age horizon)
field_legend.n20: Standing footprints built in or after 2020 (post-2020 infill volume)
field_legend.dh: Decade histogram counts aligned with top-level decade_bins array (1830s..2020s)
field_legend.lm: Total designated City of Houston Landmarks inside boundary
field_legend.plm: Protected Landmarks (PLM) with substantive anti-demolition protection
field_legend.vlm: Non-protected Landmarks subject only to 90-day demolition waiver delay
field_legend.gb: Preservation Houston Good Brick Award recipient sites inside boundary
field_legend.nrp: Individual National Register of Historic Places (NRHP) listed properties
field_legend.lhc: Documented Lost Houston demolished landmark sites inside boundary
field_legend.pc: Total unique normalized 13-digit HCAD tax parcels inside boundary
field_legend.rpc: Unique residential parcels (HCAD State Class A* single-family/townhome/condo & B* multi-family)
field_legend.sfc: Unique single-family detached/townhome parcels (HCAD State Class A1)
field_legend.occ: Unique residential parcels with situs-matched homestead occupancy (individual or family trust at situs)
field_legend.ftc: Unique non-corporate family trust / living trust / estate residential parcels
field_legend.llc: Unique residential parcels owned by corporate LLC / LP / INC / investment vehicles
field_legend.abs: Unique non-corporate, non-trust absentee individual residential parcels
field_legend.chp: Unique residential parcels protected by an enacted COH Chapter 42 SMLS or SMBL ordinance
field_legend.slp: Unique residential parcels covered by an enacted Special Minimum Lot Size (SMLS) ordinance
field_legend.sbp: Unique residential parcels covered by an enacted Special Minimum Building Line (SMBL) ordinance
field_legend.chx: Unique residential parcels inside a Ch. 42 ordinance expiring in 2026-2031 (20-year sunset horizon)
field_legend.slo: Count of intersecting enacted SMLS ordinances
field_legend.sbo: Count of intersecting enacted SMBL ordinances
field_legend.exo: List of expiring 2026-2031 Ch. 42 ordinances [{o, t, y, est}] requiring neighborhood renewal
field_legend.cdo: Count of intersecting COH Chapter 33 Conservation Districts
field_legend.hdp: Standing building footprints inside an enacted COH Chapter 33 Historic or Heritage District
field_legend.dm: Annual unique-parcel main-building structural demolitions aligned with demo_years (2020..2026 YTD)
field_legend.dmt: Cumulative unique-parcel structural demolitions recorded across 2020-2026 YTD
field_legend.dmp40: 2020-2026 structural demolitions matched to a pre-1940 structure history where known
field_legend.sn: Primary overlapping Super Neighborhood name (where applicable)
field_legend.cd: Overlapping City Council District letter(s) (e.g. 'C' or 'C, H')
field_legend.cc: Overlapping registered Civic Club / HOA name (where applicable)
field_legend.cm: Council District metadata {letter, member, phone, email, url, term_expires}
field_legend.hl: 1937 HOLC Redlining metadata {grade, code, temp_f, delta_vs_a}
field_legend.pl: Historic Plat metadata {year_label, citation, deed_citation, has_deed_docs}
